lots.title: Provision of Asbestos Assessments
lots.description: Lot 3 of framework reference 6278 (London Borough of Bexley, Building Services Framework, Lots 1-11). This document is the PSQ Reference Appendices scoped to Lot 3 only: Appendix 1 reference form (Part A applicant details + Part B referee questionnaire) and Appendix 2 referee cover letter. The document contains no scope of works, deliverables list, KPIs, volumes, technical specification, evaluation matrix or pricing schedule for the underlying services; lot identity is asserted only via the Appendix 1 heading. The Project Management criterion in Part B references 'small and medium asbestos project works', which corroborates the lot subject matter but is not itself a technical specification.
requirements: Applicant (Part A) must supply name and contact details of applicant, name and contact details of referee, brief description of services provided with dates, and annual value (Value p/a).
Referee (Part B) must complete the assessment directly and return it to procurement@bexley.gov.uk by 18th May 2026 by 5pm. Referees must not return the completed reference to the applicant.
Referee must confirm that the services described by the applicant in Part A are accurate.

evaluation_criteria.weighting_text: Five-point scale: Failed to meet standard in all areas; Failed to meet standard in some areas; Met standard; Exceeded standard in some areas; Exceeded standard in all areas.

warnings.message: Document is a PSQ reference questionnaire (Appendix 1 reference form + Appendix 2 referee cover letter), not a technical tender specification. It contains no scope of works, deliverables, KPIs, volumes, pricing schedule, or technical requirements for the underlying Asbestos Assessments service. Tender-specification extraction was attempted on the best-available signal (the Lot 3 heading in Appendix 1) and yielded only one lot identity plus the referee-assessment dimensions from Part B. No product requirement seeds, no CPV codes, and no technical standards were recoverable from this document.
No CPV codes are present anywhere in the document body. Any CPV classification for Lot 3 must come from the parent notice or upstream process metadata, not from this PSQ reference form.

No explicit technical standards (e.g. HSG264, CAR 2012, BS ISO 17020, UKAS accreditation, licensable asbestos references) are cited in the document body. Part B references generic referee-assessment dimensions, not asbestos-specific regulatory standards.

The document defines no product requirements or purchasable line items. Asbestos-assessment scope is a service, and the body contains only a referee-rating questionnaire. product_requirement_seeds is intentionally empty; the daemon should not synthesize product candidates from this extraction.

The deadline 18th May 2026 by 5pm applies to return of the referee form to procurement@bexley.gov.uk, not to the underlying Lot 3 tender submission deadline. Do not interpret this as the lot closing date.

evidence_anchors.anchor_text: TO BE COMPLETED BY REFEREE AND RETURNED TO THE ADDRESS BELOW BY 18th May 2026 by 5pm
